generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 31 kWh LiFePO4 pack (a 36 kWh option was never sold), 6.6 kW on-board charger, no DC fast charging. Deliveries from Mar 2012, California only, about 117 delivered before CODA's Chapter 11 filing on 1 May 2013. EPA MY2012-2013. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coda_(electric_car)
